data.title: 约尔·福杰 · 终于织平整的一段围巾
data.description: 夜晚的福杰家，约尔穿红色露肩毛衣与不透的黑色连裤袜坐在沙发上，双膝并拢。她双手分别捏住浅绿围巾上缘的左右两角，在膝头轻轻展开，低头检查终于织平整的针脚，紧张的眉眼渐渐舒展开来。绿色线团放在身旁的编织篮中，阅读灯把手部和面庞照得温暖明亮。
data.location: 福杰家阅读灯旁的沙发
data.action: 两手捏住围巾上缘的左右两角，在膝头展开检查针脚，双膝并拢。
data.lighting: warm reading light on face and hands
data.camera: medium shot, three-quarter view, seated environmental portrait
data.promptProse: Holding the two upper corners of a pale-green scarf, Yor Forger spreads the fabric gently across her lap. At home in SPY x FAMILY, she examines the even rows of stitches with lowered ruby eyes and a relieved little smile. A crimson off-shoulder sweater and opaque black tights cover her seated figure, knees together. A matching green yarn ball rests in a basket beside the sofa. Electric reading light reveals black hair and gold earrings. One woman, empty hands holding only fabric, no text.
